name: Fetch 'n' Fletch
summary: Tan’jani offers to teach you how to make spears for the Horde’s headhunters. You are sent to Turner's Logging Camp for wood to shape into spears.

sections.title: Wood for Spears
sections.body: Tan’jani, a headhunter, asks you to gather wood at Turner's Logging Camp, the human camp to the west. With a knife, you can sharpen the lumber into spears for sticking humans before they see you coming. Tan’jani wants you to bring the spears back.

faq.answer: Tan’jani is a headhunter who offers to teach you to make spears.

faq.q: What does Tan’jani want me to get?
faq.answer: Tan’jani asks you to gather wood from peasant woodpiles in Turner's Logging Camp and shape it into makeshift spears.
The wood is at peasant woodpiles in Turner's Logging Camp, the human camp to the west.
Tan’jani says headhunters use spears to strike humans before they see them coming.
